useCases.title: Clear bureaucracy from government services
useCases.body: Map a service as it really runs, remove the steps that add nothing, and publish the approved version. Tasree3 is built for the re-engineering work the UAE's Zero Government Bureaucracy programme calls for.
useCases.status: Phrase as alignment with the programme, never as government endorsement (EV-410 note).

useCases.title: Turn event logs into an as-is map
useCases.body: Upload CSV, JSON, PDF or DOCX files, or connect an HRMS. The wizard maps case, activity and timestamp columns, explains anything it cannot read, and AI extracts events from documents.
useCases.status: Do not name the HRMS (Tamkeen HRMS is EV-470, confirm-with-meerana).

useCases.title: Find the bottleneck before the workshop
useCases.body: Switch the mined map between frequency and performance views, see the primary bottleneck, and inspect any step for waiting time and SLA conformance. The AI Copilot Consultant then explains delay, rework and what to change.

useCases.title: Audit every process against its approved model
useCases.body: Start a global audit from the Conformance Center and export the Conformance Analysis Report as PDF or Excel for compliance and internal audit teams.

useCases.title: Publish manuals and RACI matrices from one repository
useCases.body: Generate process manuals, RACI matrices, gap analyses and digital-maturity reports from the shared process repository, so documentation follows the approved process instead of a separate file.

useCases.title: Govern changes across departments
useCases.body: Send a revised model through an ordered reviewer chain to a final approver. Reviewers see an AI summary of what changed, and an archived version can be restored as a draft.

capabilities.title: Process Copilot in the BPMN editor
capabilities.body: Ask in plain language to add gateways, insert events, explain a model or analyse it for bottlenecks.

capabilities.title: Describe a process, get a BPMN draft

capabilities.title: Frequency and performance views

capabilities.title: A node inspector for every step

capabilities.title: AI Analyst and case explorer

capabilities.title: Fourteen built-in reports

capabilities.title: AI summary of changes between versions

capabilities.title: Approval cycle time and workflow history

deploymentAndSecurity.fact: Separated as-is and to-be staging, alongside encryption at rest, role-based access control and SIEM-compatible logging.
Single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID, SAML 2.0 or OIDC, including Google, Microsoft or your organisation's own identity provider.
No self-registration: your administrator provisions every user; passwords are reset by one-time code.
Six governance roles: Viewer, Author, Reviewer, Endorser, Approver and Admin.
Every approval captures a version, with full history and one-click rollback.
A user access audit report shows who can see and change what.
Designed and developed in the United Arab Emirates by Meerana.

integrations.fact: Identity: Microsoft Entra ID, SAML 2.0 and OIDC single sign-on; Google and Microsoft sign-in.
Data in: CSV, JSON, PDF and DOCX event sources, or a connected HRMS, with automatic header mapping.
Models: BPMN 2.0 XML import and export.
Outputs: PDF, Excel and PowerPoint exports; maps as PNG, PDF or animated GIF; audit reports as PDF or Excel.
AI provider settings that accept your organisation's own keys.

faq.q: Do we need clean event logs to start?
faq.a: No. You can model in the editor, describe a process in plain language, or upload CSV, JSON, PDF or DOCX files. AI extracts events from documents and the wizard maps the required fields.

faq.q: Which notations does Tasree3 support?
faq.a: BPMN 2.0, EPC and value chains, plus organisation diagrams, with BPMN 2.0 XML import and export.

faq.q: Can Tasree3 run on our own infrastructure?
faq.a: It can run in your own cloud or data centre, in the region you choose. Tell us your requirements and we will confirm the configuration with you.

faq.q: How are process changes approved?
faq.a: Through an ordered chain of reviewers and a final approver. Each approval captures a version, reviewers see an AI summary of the changes, and earlier versions can be restored.

faq.q: Does Tasree3 work in Arabic?
faq.a: Yes. Users switch between English and Arabic at sign-in, and the platform supports right-to-left layouts.

faq.q: Do we need new cameras?

faq.q: Can Yisbir run without the public cloud?
faq.a: Yes. It can run fully on-premises, or in the cloud or a hybrid set-up if you prefer.

faq.q: Does Yisbir use face recognition?
faq.a: Face recognition is an optional module that each organisation switches on or off for its own deployment. Our demonstrations focus on other detections.

faq.q: What can it detect on live cameras?
faq.a: Fire and smoke, missing helmets and vests, restricted-zone entry, falls, unsafe work practices, after-hours intrusion, perimeter breaches, crowd density and attendance. Ask us about uniform compliance for your site.

faq.q: Which languages can it transcribe?
faq.a: More than 50, with speaker diarization so each passage is attributed to a speaker.
